user.title: Add a virtual TV
user.description: Creates a TV that your iPhone or iPad can control from Control Center → Remote. Make one per room.

input.title: Input / source
input.description: What a long press of the TV button does.

data_description.input_mode: Single: run one action, e.g. open the TV's input menu. Cycle: each long press moves to the next input below.
data_description.input_long: Runs on a long press of the TV button in single mode.

data_description.long_press_ms: How long to hold Select, Back, Siri or the TV button for a long press.
data_description.double_tap_ms: Only used by the TV button double-press.
data_description.repeat_controls: IR TVs often handle repeats badly; turn off any that misbehave.
data_description.swipe_threshold: Touchpad units (0-1000). Lower = shorter swipes count.
data_description.home_double_press: On automatically when a double-press action is set. Delays a single press by the window.

data_description.allow_pairing: Lets a new phone pair. Switches itself off after a successful pairing.
